eligibility.advisoryBoundary: the client may request reconnect and render recovery status, but must not infer game state or priority progression

supported: reconnect recovery is bounded by a server-issued session identity
stale or revoked recovery requests fail without mutating the shared game state
deferred: UNDECIDED: whether disconnect/presence changes consume a revision
UNDECIDED: whether successful reconnect must explicitly show rejoined
UNDECIDED: which operations or priority progression are allowed while a seat is disconnected

outcomes.unavailable: a disconnected or expired seat receives a safe recovery status without a game-state mutation
outcomes.accepted: a resolved reconnect policy restores the authorized seat to the canonical shared projection
outcomes.rejected: stale, revoked, or mismatched recovery requests leave revision and Core state unchanged
outcomes.failed: ambiguous presence revision, rejoined indication, or disconnected-seat operation policy reaches implementation

sameSlice: any reconnect adapter that infers policy from client-local state
retained: existing lobby credential recovery until game-session semantics are decided

positive: the resolved reconnect policy is proven by both seats against the same canonical revision and projection
negative: the design gate stops before local or live stages while any reconnect semantic remains undecided

nextSlices: resolve disconnected-seat operation and priority policy
